description: Ambush at the Gate: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: A {client} courier convoy is about to come through the gate at {system} and {enemy} knows. Get there first, clear what is waiting and cover the convoy as it arrives.
{enemy} has laid an ambush at the gate. Intelligence says fighters and a frigate. {client} has a convoy due in minutes. Break the ambush before the freighters arrive.
The convoy will come through the gate whether we are ready or not. Be ready. The ambush is already in place.
success: The convoy arrives to a clear gate. {client} pays {captain} and sends the freighters on.
The ambush is broken. {client} pays and asks how you knew where to look.
A clean gate. {client} pays and will put the intelligence officer's name on the report.
failure: The convoy arrives into the ambush. {client} pays nothing.
You miss the ambush and the freighters pay for it. {client} withdraws the offer.
radio-hidden: Contact. They are hiding in the gate shadow. Five fighters and a frigate.
The trap is real. Go for the frigate first.
{enemy} ambush in the shadow. Weapons free.
radio-convoy: Gate flash. The convoy is arriving. Cover them.
Convoy transiting now. They are going to be right behind you.
Freighters through the gate. Do not let them get hit.
radio-second: Second wave! Gunships heading for the freighters.
They saved the bombers for the convoy. Intercept them.
Bombers incoming, right. Stay on the freighters.
